option.hitsound.desc:
Select which sound plays when you hit a note.
The list comes from data/hitsoundList.txt, so you can add your own
by appending a name to that txt and putting the sound file in sounds/hitsounds/.
option.marvelousRatings.desc: If checked, a 'Marvelous' rating is added before Sick.
option.judgementNameCompat.desc:
Psych 0.6.3/0.7.3/1.0.4 have no 'Marvelous' judgement, so mods that map judgements by name (rating == 'sick') drop every Marvelous hit: accuracy falls and combo stops rising.
If checked, scripts read the 1.0.4 name (Marvelous -> Sick); the engine's own HUD, results, scoring and hitsounds still use the real judgement, and scripts can still read Note.ratingRaw.
Only affects 1.0.4 compat mode.
option.judgementPreset.desc:
Apply a preset judgement timing (Leather Engine / Psych Engine / Friday Night Funkin').
Manually changing any window below will switch this to Custom.
option.marvelousWindow.desc:
Changes the amount of time you have
for hitting a "Marvelous" in milliseconds.
(Manually editing sets Judgement Preset to Custom)
option.osuTailJudgement.desc: Judge Hold Note releases by tail timing (osu!mania style). Affects replays.
option.tailWindowMult.desc:
Tail judgement window = normal judgement window × this multiplier.
Higher = more forgiving hold releases. (0.5x - 5x)
option.luattf.desc: Change the font of lua (if lua is not set).
option.opponentfe.desc: If unchecked, the flickering effect will be canceled after the Bot hits.
option.sidehud.desc: If unchecked, values such as Sick, Good on the left side of the game will not be displayed.
option.blurnote.desc: If checked, the note will have a motion blur effect.
option.imv4sc.desc: If checked, the color of scoreTxt will change to the color of your opponent's healthBar.
option.oldmodsmenu.desc: If checked, the old mods menu will be used instead of the new one.
option.noteSplashes.desc: If unchecked, hitting "Sick!" notes won't show particles.
option.noteSkin.desc:
Select the Note texture. (0.7.3+ only)
The list comes from images/noteSkins/list.txt, so mods can add their own skins.
Only shown when the engine compatibility mode is 0.7.3 or 1.0.4.
option.noteStyle.desc:
Choose which base Note material to use.
Old: classic 0.6.3 NOTE_assets.
New: 0.7.3 noteSkins/NOTE_assets.
Independent of the engine compatibility mode.
option.noteRGBMode.desc:
Controls the RGB coloring shader used by white-based Note textures (0.7.3+ noteSkins).
Follow Chart: the chart's "No Note RGB" setting decides (default).
On: always color Notes with the shader.
Off: never color Notes, they keep the raw texture colors.
option.splashSkin.desc:
Select the Note Splash texture.
The list comes from images/noteSplashes/list.txt, so mods can add their own splashes.
Works in every engine compatibility mode.
option.hideHud.desc: If checked, hides most HUD elements.
option.timeBarType.desc: What should the Time Bar display?
option.flashing.desc: Uncheck this if you're sensitive to flashing lights!
option.camZooms.desc: If unchecked, the camera won't zoom in on a beat hit.
option.scoreZoom.desc: If unchecked, disables the Score text zooming every time you hit a note.
option.healthBarAlpha.desc: How much transparent should the health bar and icons be.
option.showFP.desc: If checked, the current FP count will be shown in the score text, can be toggled in-game with F7
option.newFPPreview.desc: If enabled, new FP algorithm will be shown in the Counter
option.pauseMusic.desc: What song do you prefer for the Pause Screen?
option.checkForUpdates.desc: On Release builds, turn this on to check for updates when you start the game.
option.checkForPrereleases.desc: Also check for prerelease or preview versions when looking for updates.
option.comboStacking.desc: If unchecked, Ratings and Combo won't stack, saving on System Memory and making them easier to read.
option.lowQuality.desc: If checked, disables some background details, decreases loading times and improves performance.
option.globalAntialiasing.desc: If unchecked, disables anti-aliasing, increases performance at the cost of sharper visuals.
option.shaders.desc: If unchecked, disables shaders. It's used for some visual effects, and also CPU intensive for weaker PCs.
option.framerate.desc: How many times per second the game logic updates (physics, animations, input).
option.drawFramerate.desc:
How many frames per second the game renders at.
Can be higher than Update Framerate for smooth visuals on high-refresh monitors.
Works best when Separate Update/Draw is enabled.
option.cacheOnGPU.desc:
If checked, allows the GPU to be used for caching textures, decreasing RAM usage.
Don't turn this on if you have a shitty Graphics Card.
option.preloadAssets.desc:
If checked, preloads script images before gameplay with a loading screen.
Reduces lag during songs at the cost of initial load time.
option.windowedmode.desc: Choose your window mode (Press ACCEPT to apply changes).
option.closeAnimStyle.desc:
Play an animation before the window closes when you press Alt+F4 or click X.
Off: close instantly.
Squeeze: squish the window height first, then the width.
Zoom: shrink everything toward the center.
Drop: shrink while falling down.
Slide: shrink while sliding to the left.
option.closeAnimSpeed.desc: How fast the close animation plays. 1.0x is the default speed; higher values play faster.
option.controllerMode.desc: Check this if you want to play with a controller instead of using your Keyboard.
option.compatEngine.desc:
Choose which Psych Engine version's mod API/UI to emulate.
Auto keeps the previous behavior (0.6.3, or 0.7.3 if the old compatibility toggle was on).
Note-related callbacks (onSpawnNote, goodNoteHit, note splash...) adapt automatically.
option.compatibility_mode.desc: If checked, lua will use the Psych Engine 0.7.3 method to be compatible with Psych Engine 0.7.3 mods.
option.downScroll.desc: If checked, notes go Down instead of Up, simple enough.
option.middleScroll.desc: If checked, your notes get centered.
option.opponentStrums.desc: If unchecked, opponent notes get hidden.
option.ghostTapping.desc: If checked, you won't get misses from pressing keys while there are no notes able to be hit.
option.noReset.desc: If checked, pressing Reset won't do anything.
option.smoothhpbar.desc:
If checked, the HP bar and icon movements will become smoother.
For some levels, there may be unspeakable bugs and performance penalty.
option.trackAlpha.desc: Changes the opacity of the note underlay.
option.hitsoundVolume.desc: Funny notes do "Tick!" when you hit them.
option.ratingOffset.desc:
Changes how late/early you have to hit for a "Sick!".
Higher values mean you have to hit later.
option.sickWindow.desc: Changes the amount of time you have for hitting a "Sick!" in milliseconds.
option.goodWindow.desc: Changes the amount of time you have for hitting a "Good" in milliseconds.
option.badWindow.desc: Changes the amount of time you have for hitting a "Bad" in milliseconds.
option.tipText: Press C to customize your android controls.
option.safeFrames.desc: Changes how many frames you have for hitting a note earlier or late.
option.sustainsAsOneNote.desc:
If checked, Hold Notes can't be pressed if you miss, and count as a single Hit/Miss.
Uncheck this if you prefer the old Input System.
option.saveReplayData.desc:
If checked, the game will record your inputs and save them with your score.
This allows you to watch replays later.
option.lastNoteAnimation.desc: If checked, character animation will only use the last pressed note's direction when multiple notes are hit simultaneously, reducing visual twitching.
option.hscriptErrorHandling.desc: If checked, Hscript will handle errors the same way as LUA, which may have some impact on Hscript.
option.ignoreErrorLoopScripts.desc: If a Lua/HScript keeps throwing errors every frame, ignore that script once it reaches the error limit instead of spamming errors non-stop.
option.scriptErrorLimit.desc: How many consecutive errors a script may throw before it is ignored.
option.extrasettings.title: Extra Settings
option.newchartingstate.desc: If checked, the new charting state will be used instead of the old one.
option.segmentedCharts.desc:
How charts that were split across several files are loaded.
Auto: <song>-0.json, <song>-1.json, ... are played as one song.
Manifest: only the parts listed in <song>.parts.json are merged.
Off: every chart file stays its own difficulty (the stock behavior).
At song select, press M (the on-screen D button on Android) to override this for one song.
Online only promises single-file charts: a segmented chart combined with the huge-chart cache is out of scope and is not validated there.
option.chartAutosave.desc: If checked, chart editors will automatically save backups and create autosave data (also when entering Playtest). Unchecked by default so your chart is NEVER saved without you pressing Save manually.
option.oldPauseMenu.desc: If checked, the old 0.6.3-style pause menu with Alphabet list will be used instead of the new acrylic one.
option.seiuMenuFx.desc: If enabled, the main menu, freeplay and story menus get glowing auroras, particles and beat-synced pulses. Disable for a cleaner look.
option.freeplayAutoPreview.desc: If enabled, Freeplay automatically plays the selected song's background music, following your selection.
option.autoExtractAssets.desc:
If enabled, the game will automatically extract necessary assets from the APK on first launch.
Disable this if you have manually placed assets and want faster startup.
option.adaptiveResolution.desc:
Instead of the locked 1280x720, automatically adapt to the device's maximum resolution,
filling the whole screen with sharper visuals.
Takes effect after restarting the game.
May lower performance on weak devices.
option.nativeInputDialog.desc: When enabled, clicking a text box will open a native OS input window, fixing IME candidate/override window not showing.
option.backup.export.desc: Export all game data (scores, settings, progress) to a single encrypted backup file.
option.backup.import.desc: Restore all game data from a previously created backup file.
DataBackup.success.title: Backup Successful
DataBackup.error.title: Backup Failed
DataBackup.error.message: Failed to save backup file. Please try again.
DataBackup.error.empty: The selected file is empty or invalid.
DataBackup.error.invalidFile: The selected file is not a valid backup file or has been corrupted.
DataBackup.error.fileError: An error occurred while reading the file.
DataBackup.confirm.title: Restore Data?
DataBackup.confirm.message:
This will overwrite ALL current game data (scores, settings, progress) with the data from the backup file.

This action cannot be undone!

Are you sure you want to continue?
DataBackup.restored.title: Restore Successful
DataBackup.restored.message:
Game data has been successfully restored!

The game will now reload to apply changes.
DataBackup.androidWarning.title: Important: Data Backup Recommended
DataBackup.androidWarning.message:
Your game data (scores, settings, progress) is stored in the app's internal storage.

If you uninstall or reinstall the game, ALL data may be permanently lost!

We strongly recommend creating a backup now to save your progress.

Would you like to create a backup now?
DataBackup.info:
Backup includes: Highscores, song ratings, settings, keybinds,
score history, replay data, and week progress.
Saved as an encrypted .SEB file.
option.gameplaySettings.title: Gameplay Settings
option.runInBackground.desc:
If checked, the game will continue running even when minimized or unfocused.
Overrides Auto Pause setting.
option.backgroundDim.desc:
If checked, the game will reduce volume when unfocused.
Only works when Run in Background is enabled.
option.separateUpdateDraw.desc:
Separates rendering from game logic so they can run at different speeds.
Game logic stays at your set framerate while rendering can go higher.
May improve FPS on high-refresh monitors without breaking physics.
option.threadedRendering.desc:
If enabled, moves rendering work to a separate thread.
Can improve performance on multi-core CPUs.
Requires game restart to take full effect.
option.highPerformanceMode.desc:
If enabled, removes the update accumulation cap
for maximum update rate. Automatically enables
Separate Update/Draw mode. No threading issues.
controls.rebinding_hint:
Hold ESC to Cancel
Hold Backspace to Delete
controls.hint_clown:
If you pressed Accept in Gamepad mode and nothing happened…
next time don't come to this setting without a controller!
option.traceConsole.desc: Enable the Trace Console for real-time debug output monitoring with colored, multilingual trace messages.
option.traceConsoleLevel.desc: Set the minimum trace level shown in console. DEBUG shows all traces, ERROR only shows errors.
option.clearImageCache.desc: Press ENTER to release all unused cached images from memory, including the LRU pool.
option.clearImageCache.none: No unused cached images to release.
option.touchSwipe.desc:
If enabled, you can swipe/scroll by dragging with the mouse or touching the screen.
Disable if you prefer standard click-only navigation.
option.touchControls.desc:
Bring the Android mobile controls (virtual pad / hitbox) to PC, usable with mouse or touchscreen.
Mode and layout can be changed in the Touch Controls menu.
option.androidSettings.title: Android Settings
option.hitboxExtraToggle.desc:
If enabled, shows extra SPACE and SHIFT buttons on the hitbox.
Disable to hide them.
option.hitboxExtraPos.desc:
Choose where the extra SPACE/SHIFT buttons appear:
Bottom (default) or Top.
option.hitboxPressAlpha.desc:
How visible the hitbox blocks become while you are pressing them.
The blocks stay fully transparent when not pressed.
option.hitboxBorder.desc:
Show thin borders around each hitbox block.
Helps you locate the tap zones even when the blocks are transparent.
option.mobileCAlpha.desc: How transparent the virtual pad buttons are when not pressed.
option.storageType.desc:
Choose how the game accesses storage.
EXTERNAL_DATA (safest) → /Android/data/<package>/files
EXTERNAL (legacy) → /storage/emulated/0/.<game>
EXTERNAL_OBB → /Android/obb/<package>
EXTERNAL_MEDIA → /Android/media/<package>

If the selected path fails, the game falls back automatically.
option.turboMode.desc:
Extreme-chart switch: forces botplay and settles dense sections as data,
so millions of notes stay playable. Off = stock behavior.
Online disables it automatically.
option.scriptArgReuse.desc:
Reuses one argument array for script callbacks instead of allocating one per hit.
Stops the GC stutter on dense charts. Off = stock per-hit allocation.
Online disables it automatically.
option.perfMode.desc:
Master switch for extreme-chart optimizations. Off = stock gameplay.
Only enable on absurd-NPS charts; online disables it automatically.
option.bulkSkip.desc:
Bulk-skips already expired notes to avoid spawn-then-miss churn.
Auto-disabled with Lua/HScript, replay or online.
option.fastSort.desc:
Sorts only visible/alive notes each frame. Turn off if a mod needs
the full group order; online disables it automatically.
option.limitNotes.desc:
Maximum notes alive at once. 0 = unlimited (high-end machines only).
Higher values cost more CPU/GPU and memory.
Online disables this cap automatically.
option.chartCache.desc:
Caches the note list of huge charts (64 MB+) so re-entering skips parsing
and folding. Off always re-reads the chart file.
option.chartCacheCompress.desc:
Compresses the cached note list (290 MB -> 2 MB measured), costing about
one second per load/save. Off = fastest load, more disk.
option.clearChartCache.desc:
Press ENTER to delete every cached note list. Do this after editing a chart
in place if the tool preserved its size and timestamp.
option.clearChartCache.done: Deleted every cached chart note list (~{mb} MB).
option.disableGC.desc:
Disables hxcpp garbage collection while playing.
Trades memory for stable frame time (H-Slice style).
Re-enabled automatically when leaving the song. Use with care.
option.gfxCpuRelease.desc:
During play, frees CPU-side copies of large textures (>=2048px) once they are on the GPU.
Rendering is pixel-identical; saves a lot of RAM on songs with big character sheets.
option.asyncImageLoading.desc:
When entering a song, shows a loading screen and decodes character sheets
on background threads in parallel with real progress.
option.gfxLruCache.desc:
Keeps decoded big textures (VRAM budget ~1.5GB) after leaving a song,
so replaying the same song skips decoding entirely.
Pixel-identical; turning off flushes the cache immediately.
option.gfxRuntimeRepack.desc:
While preloading, trims fully transparent borders off big character sheets
(>=2048px) in memory and packs frames tightly, shrinking VRAM and upload time.
Pixel-identical rendering; original files are never modified.
option.showStorageRootWarning.desc: Warn once at launch when the game's data is not kept on the public root directory (/storage/emulated/0/.<game>), where mods, saves and the file manager can see it.
option.showWatermark.desc:
Show a small version + build watermark in the bottom-right corner of the menus.
Hidden automatically while a song is playing; it never takes any input.
TestBuildNotice.title: Test Build
TestBuildNotice.body:
Test build - {version} ({build}).
This version is still in development: features may be incomplete or change at any time, and save data may change format between builds.
Keep a backup of anything you care about.
TestBuildNotice.continueHint: Press ENTER / SPACE, or click Continue
NoteOptimisationNotice.title: Note Optimisation
NoteOptimisationNotice.body:
Note optimisation - read this first
The note optimisation in this engine is a side feature, not a product. It exists so that enormous charts (tens of millions of notes) can at least be played; it was not written by a dedicated note-optimisation project and does not try to match one.
If it is slower or rougher than such an engine, that is expected. Please use that engine instead of filing a complaint here.
(Shown once per launch, when this page is opened.)
CopyState.missingBody:
The game files have not been extracted yet, but "Auto-Extract Assets" is turned off.

Settings, language and image files will be missing or broken.

Extract now, or enable the option in Android Settings.
CopyState.continueWarning: The game will continue with missing files; some content may be broken.
Storage.rootWarning.title: Storage Location Warning
option.render.desc:
Records the current song to a video file.
Turn on "Render on Song Start" in Options -> Render Video; no hotkey is used.
Encoding is done by ffmpeg, which must be reachable on PATH.
option.previewRender.desc:
Runs everything a real render does (fixed timestep, per-frame capture)
but writes no file. Use it to check timing before encoding.
option.renderFps.desc:
Frames per second the video is captured and encoded at. Free choice, 15 to 480.
While rendering, the game is pinned to this rate and every captured frame stands
for exactly 1/fps of song time, so the video is always as long as the song even
if your PC cannot hold the rate.
Set it to a rate your PC can actually draw at for smooth footage.
option.renderCodec.desc:
Encoder used when rendering a video.
GPU encoders (NVENC/AMF/QSV) need a supported GPU and ffmpeg build.
VP8/VP9 write .webm, everything else .mp4.
option.renderMode.desc:
CRF/CQP: constant quality (use Render Quality below).
VBR: target bitrate. CBR: fixed bitrate, predictable file size.
option.renderQuality.desc:
Quality for CRF/CQP. Lower = better quality and bigger file.
18 is visually near-lossless; 0 is lossless.
option.renderBitrate.desc:
Target bitrate in Mbit/s, used by the VBR and CBR rate modes.
12 is good for 1080p60; raise it for 1440p/4K.
option.renderBufferFrames.desc:
How many frames may wait for the encoder before frames are dropped.
This is what caps render memory (frames x width x height x 4 bytes).
Raise it if frames drop on a slow encoder; lower it to use less RAM.
option.renderAudio.desc:
Mixes the song's Inst / Voices tracks into the rendered video.
When no audio file can be found (an embedded-only song, for example) the video
will have no sound.
option.renderOnSongStart.desc:
When on, recording starts automatically the moment a song starts - no hotkey.
It stops by itself when the song ends, or when you leave the song.
Output goes to the render_video folder next to the game.
